$comment: The data map in machine-readable form: one entry per field of NZTA's register (pipeline/expected_schema.json) and one per column of NZTA's registrations dashboard export (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md section D). docs/DATA_MAP.md is the same map for people, with the measured figures; this file holds no measured figure, because figures go stale and belong to the doc and to a later per-build output. Read by pipeline/tests/test_data_map.py today; planned readers are the chart rule table and Build (which fields are askable and how), the pipeline (which fields may reach a published file) and the method page (each field's definition line). config/dimensions.json stays the list of what Build offers today; a field reaches it only by being bound in config/pipeline.json and given a derive block. Privacy classes are PROPOSED and not approved by the user: until the user approves them, the work order's section 3 is binding (no owner field, postcode or anything derived from VIN11 is published). Each definition is prose for the method page, not code: where it cannot say what a field holds without naming a value or a source's own words, it names them.

approval.$comment: Becomes 'approved' only on the user's word, recorded in a decision record named in decision. Until then nothing marked not_published_before_review is published, whatever this file says after the review, and every field in owner_groups stays unpublished.

$owner_groups_comment: Groups whose fields describe or locate the owner. The work order's section 3: none of them is published before the user approves the privacy review.

cardinality.$comment: A field is 'few' when it has at most this many recorded values in the dataset it serves (the in-scope dataset for register fields; for dashboard columns, the dataset built from the export, whose scope rule is the same), not counting the forms that mean 'not recorded'; otherwise 'many'. Eight because the site's line palette carries eight distinguishable colours (src/lib/theme.ts, D-060). Numbers, identifiers and free text are always 'many'.

proposed_public.meaning: Describes the vehicle, not its owner. May be published in aggregates once bound.

not_published_before_review.meaning: Describes the owner, or locates the owner. Built and tested privately; published only after the user approves the privacy review, and then as its after_review says.

never_published.meaning: Pulled for the pipeline's own use or kept in the private archive, never published itself.

never_pulled.meaning: Never asked for from NZTA's service (config/pipeline.json register_archive.never_pulled).

derive_reads.$comment: Which bound fields a derive kind in config/dimensions.json reads without naming them in its derive block. A test resolves every dimension's fields from its derive block (any string or key that is a logical field of config/pipeline.json) plus these. An item with a dot is a path into config/pipeline.json whose value is a logical field name, or an object whose keys that are logical field names are read; an item without a dot is a logical field name. vehicle_year is listed by name because the model registry's conditions name it as a range (vehicle_year_min, vehicle_year_max).
derive_reads.$by_field_comment: Fields read whenever a dimension reads the field the key points at. The hybrid classification (pipeline.json hybrid_classification, pipeline/normalise.py) replaces the engine field's motive power using the make, the model and the model registry's conditions, so every dimension that reads motive power reads those too.

moves_together.$comment: How strongly two fields move together is measured each build and is not stored here (docs/DATA_MAP.md, Moves together with). Listed here are the pairs that move together because of how they are defined or built, so the site never offers them as a finding. A field and any dimension derived from it are always such a pair and are not listed. basis: by_construction where the data shows the rule (docs/MODEL_AND_AGE.md section 1, or the site's own derivation); by_definition_inferred where it rests on NZTA's codes and is marked inferred - confirm in the doc. a and b are register field names or dimension ids.

fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.definition: A row number in NZTA's service, used to page the pull. It is not a property of the vehicle.
fields.privacy_reason: A row number with no meaning to a visitor; it picks out one row of one service release.

fields.name: FIRST_NZ_REGISTRATION_YEAR
fields.definition: The year the vehicle was first registered in New Zealand.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the vehicle; it is the time axis of every survivors chart.

fields.name: FIRST_NZ_REGISTRATION_MONTH
fields.definition: The month of the year, 1 to 12, in which the vehicle was first registered in New Zealand.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the vehicle; with the year it is the month axis.

fields.name: VEHICLE_YEAR
fields.definition: A year NZTA records for the vehicle: for NZ-new vehicles first registered from 2007, the year of first registration; for used imports, a year from the vehicle's life overseas. It is not the model year.

fields.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
fields.definition: NZTA's vehicle type, the broad kind of vehicle. It decides which vehicles the site counts.

fields.name: BODY_TYPE
fields.definition: NZTA's body type, the shape of the body. The same body type can sit under more than one vehicle type.

fields.name: CLASS
fields.definition: NZTA's vehicle equipment standard class, a short code. One code reads like 'not applicable' and is a real class of light goods vehicle.

fields.name: MAKE
fields.definition: The make as NZTA records it, after NZTA's own cleaning. The site maps it to a brand through the brand registry.

fields.name: MODEL
fields.definition: The model name as NZTA records it, after NZTA's own cleaning. A model name means something only inside its make.

fields.name: BASIC_COLOUR
fields.definition: The vehicle's main colour, as one of NZTA's colour words.

fields.name: NUMBER_OF_SEATS
fields.definition: The number of seats NZTA records for the vehicle.

fields.name: NUMBER_OF_AXLES
fields.definition: The number of axles NZTA records for the vehicle.

fields.name: TRANSMISSION_TYPE
fields.definition: The gearbox, recorded for NZ-new vehicles: the number of gears and the kind of gearbox.

fields.name: SYNTHETIC_GREENHOUSE_GAS
fields.definition: The refrigerant in the vehicle's air-conditioning system, as recorded at registration.

fields.name: MOTIVE_POWER
fields.definition: The vehicle's primary fuel or power source, in NZTA's own terms. The hybrid codes do not say whether a hybrid is mild or full.

fields.name: ALTERNATIVE_MOTIVE_POWER
fields.definition: A second fuel the vehicle can run on. Read as empty when the vehicle has none (inferred - confirm).

fields.name: CC_RATING
fields.definition: Engine capacity in cubic centimetres. Electric vehicles hold 0 or 1, which is not an engine size.

fields.name: POWER_RATING
fields.definition: Engine or motor power in kilowatts, recorded for NZ-new vehicles.

fields.name: FC_COMBINED
fields.definition: Fuel consumption over the combined test cycle, in litres per 100 km, as NZTA records it. Stored by NZTA as text.

fields.name: FC_URBAN
fields.definition: Fuel consumption over the urban test cycle, in litres per 100 km, recorded mostly for NZ-new vehicles. Stored by NZTA as text.

fields.name: FC_EXTRA_URBAN
fields.definition: Fuel consumption over the extra-urban test cycle, in litres per 100 km, recorded mostly for NZ-new vehicles. Stored by NZTA as text.

fields.name: GROSS_VEHICLE_MASS
fields.definition: Gross vehicle mass: the vehicle's maximum laden mass in kilograms, as recorded.

fields.name: VDAM_WEIGHT
fields.definition: The maximum laden weight the vehicle is allowed on the road, in kilograms, recorded for heavy vehicles. A different measure from gross vehicle mass.

fields.name: HEIGHT
fields.definition: The vehicle's height in millimetres, recorded for heavy vehicles.

fields.name: WIDTH
fields.definition: The vehicle's width in millimetres, recorded for heavy vehicles.

fields.name: IMPORT_STATUS
fields.definition: Whether the vehicle was new or used when first registered in New Zealand, or re-registered, or scratch-built. It decides which other fields exist for the vehicle.

fields.name: ORIGINAL_COUNTRY
fields.definition: The country where the vehicle was principally manufactured: 'built in', not the brand's home country.

fields.name: PREVIOUS_COUNTRY
fields.definition: The country where a used import was registered before New Zealand. It does not apply to NZ-new vehicles.

fields.name: NZ_ASSEMBLED
fields.definition: Whether the vehicle was assembled or built in New Zealand, or imported built up.

fields.name: TLA
fields.definition: The district (territorial authority) of the registered owner's address as at the snapshot. Not where the vehicle is used, and not where it was first registered.
fields.privacy_reason: Locates the owner; crossed with fine vehicle detail it can come down to one vehicle.

published_exceptions.$comment: Kept by D-078's point 3, decided by Claude (unreviewed) on the user's option that the region map still draws. The work order's section 3 names region among the fields not published without asking: whether the slice stays is the user's.

fields.name: POSTCODE
fields.definition: The postcode of the registered owner's address, stored by NZTA as a number. Kept in the private archive only.
fields.privacy_reason: Locates the owner more finely than a district; many postcodes hold only a few vehicles (D-076, D-079).

fields.name: VEHICLE_USAGE
fields.definition: How the vehicle is used, in a few broad groups. Read as the latest usage recorded, not the usage at first registration: shown for rental; other values not tested.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes how the owner uses the vehicle (the work order's section 3 names it an owner field).

fields.name: INDUSTRY_CLASS
fields.definition: The class of industry a vehicle is associated with (NZTA's words), read as the owner's industry (inferred - confirm). At least partly the current owner's, not the first owner's.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the owner (the work order's section 3 names it an owner field).

fields.name: ROAD_TRANSPORT_CODE
fields.definition: The kind of road transport service, recorded mainly for vehicles in commercial road transport; read as empty when the vehicle has none (inferred - confirm). Provided by the owner or dealer and not verified by NZTA.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the owner's business, in the owner's own words.

fields.name: SUBMODEL
fields.definition: The variant, as free text. Never grouped on; at most searched.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the vehicle; never offered as a breakdown, so it is not published as one.

fields.name: MVMA_MODEL_CODE
fields.definition: A model code the manufacturer assigns to NZ-new vehicles. Used only as a lookup key, and not a clean one.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the vehicle; a lookup key, not published as a breakdown.

fields.name: INDUSTRY_MODEL_CODE
fields.definition: A model code recorded for used imports, mostly Japanese model codes, not validated by NZTA. Used only as a lookup key.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the vehicle; a lookup key, not published as a breakdown.

fields.name: VIN11
fields.definition: The first 11 characters of the vehicle identification number. Kept in the private archive only.
fields.privacy_reason: Narrows a vehicle to a handful; a field derived from it may be published only once checked against the data and approved (D-076).

fields.name: CHASSIS7
fields.definition: The first 7 characters of the chassis number. Never pulled.
fields.privacy_reason: Identifies a vehicle and serves no question (D-062, D-076).

fields.name: ENGINE_NUMBER
fields.definition: The engine number. Never pulled.
fields.privacy_reason: Identifies a vehicle and serves no question (D-062, D-076).

fields.name: Registration month
fields.definition: The dashboard's registration month. NZTA calls it the date of first ownership, which may differ from the first registration in New Zealand; in count it agrees with the register's month of first registration.

fields.name: Import status
fields.definition: The register's import status, as the dashboard holds it.

fields.name: Vehicle type
fields.definition: The register's vehicle type, as the dashboard holds it.

fields.name: Body type
fields.definition: The register's body type, as the dashboard holds it.

fields.name: Motive power
fields.definition: The register's motive power, as the dashboard holds it; '-' where the register has none.

fields.name: Make
fields.definition: The make, as the dashboard holds it. A few makes are spelled differently from the register.

fields.name: Model
fields.definition: NZTA's cleaned model name, which splits some nameplates more finely than the register.

fields.name: Country of origin
fields.definition: The country where the vehicle was principally manufactured, as the dashboard holds it.

fields.name: Vehicle year
fields.definition: The register's vehicle year, as the dashboard holds it. Not the model year.

fields.name: Vehicle Status
fields.definition: Whether, at the dashboard's latest monthly update, the vehicle counts as still registered or since removed. Read from the counts, not from NZTA's wording.
fields.privacy_reason: Says whether the vehicle is still registered; nothing about its owner.

fields.name: Owner Type
fields.definition: The kind of registered owner: a person, a company or other. Most likely the owner at first registration; not proven.
fields.privacy_reason: Describes the owner (the work order's section 3 names it an owner field).

fields.name: Territorial authority
fields.definition: The registered owner's district, as the dashboard holds it, with two values the register does not have.

fields.name: Vehicle usage
fields.definition: How the vehicle is used, in a finer list than the register's, at an earlier moment than the register's: consistent with the usage at first registration (shown for rental only).
fields.privacy_reason: Describes how the owner uses the vehicle (the work order's section 3 names it an owner field).
